heroes.name: Noah
heroes.about: Built the ark and survived the flood

stops.n: Here the ark came to rest after the flood
stops.q: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.

heroes.name: Abraham
heroes.about: Father of many nations, set out at God's call

stops.n: Set out with his father Terah from Ur of the Chaldeans
stops.q: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram’s wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

stops.n: Lived in Haran and left it at 75 at the word of the Lord
stops.q: So Abram departed, as the Lord had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.

stops.n: His first stop in the land of Canaan, by the oak of Moreh
stops.q: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.

stops.n: Pitched his tent between Bethel and Ai and built an altar
stops.q: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Beth-el, and pitched his tent, having Beth-el on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the Lord, and called upon the name of the Lord.

stops.n: Went down to Egypt during a famine
stops.q: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.

stops.n: Settled by the oaks of Mamre at Hebron
stops.q: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the Lord.

stops.n: Stayed for a time in Gerar with King Abimelech
stops.q: AND Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.

stops.n: Made a covenant with Abimelech at the well of the oath
stops.q: Wherefore he called that place Beer-sheba; because there they sware both of them.

stops.n: Brought Isaac to a mountain in the land of Moriah
stops.q: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

heroes.name: Sarah
heroes.about: Wife of Abraham, mother of Isaac

stops.n: Left Ur of the Chaldeans together with Abram
stops.q: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram’s wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

stops.n: Went with her husband from Haran to the land of Canaan
stops.q: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother’s son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

stops.n: The Egyptians saw that she was very beautiful
stops.q: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.

stops.n: Abimelech, king of Gerar, took her, but God intervened
stops.q: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

stops.n: Died at Kiriath Arba, that is, Hebron
stops.q: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

heroes.name: Lot
heroes.about: Abraham's nephew, rescued from Sodom

stops.n: Left Ur of the Chaldeans with his grandfather Terah and Abram
stops.q: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram’s wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

stops.n: Went with Abram from Haran
stops.q: So Abram departed, as the Lord had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.

stops.n: Came back with Abram from Egypt
stops.q: AND Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.

stops.n: Here Lot's and Abram's flocks grew too many for the land
stops.q: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth-el, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Beth-el and Hai; Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the Lord. And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

stops.n: Was sitting at the gate of Sodom when two angels came
stops.q: AND there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;

stops.n: Escaped to the little town of Zoar
stops.q: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.

heroes.name: Hagar
heroes.about: Sarah's maidservant, mother of Ishmael

stops.n: She was an Egyptian
stops.q: NOW Sarai Abram’s wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

stops.n: Wandered with her son in the wilderness of Beersheba
stops.q: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.

heroes.name: Isaac
heroes.about: Son of the promise, father of Jacob and Esau

stops.n: His father brought him to a mountain in the land of Moriah
stops.q: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

stops.n: Settled in Gerar during a famine
stops.q: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:

stops.n: Moved to Beersheba, where the Lord appeared to him
stops.q: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.

stops.n: Lived at Mamre, that is, Hebron
stops.q: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

heroes.name: Rebekah
heroes.about: Wife of Isaac, mother of Jacob and Esau

stops.n: Her brother Laban lived in Haran, and she sent Jacob there
stops.q: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;

stops.n: Lived with Isaac in Gerar
stops.q: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.

heroes.name: Jacob
heroes.about: Son of Isaac, father of the twelve tribes

stops.n: Left Beersheba and set out for Haran
stops.q: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.

stops.n: Dreamed of a ladder and called the place Bethel
stops.q: And he called the name of that place Beth-el: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.

stops.n: Served Laban in Haran for twenty years
stops.q: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.

stops.n: Met the angels of God and called the place Mahanaim
stops.q: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God’s host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

stops.n: Built himself a house and shelters for his livestock
stops.q: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

stops.n: Bought a piece of land near the city of Shechem
stops.q: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan-aram; and pitched his tent before the city.

stops.n: On the road to Ephrath, that is, Bethlehem, Rachel died
stops.q: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Beth-lehem.

stops.n: Came to his father Isaac at Mamre, that is, Hebron
stops.q: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

stops.n: Lived with his sons in the land of Goshen
stops.q: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

heroes.name: Rachel
heroes.about: Jacob's beloved wife, mother of Joseph and Benjamin

stops.n: Jacob met her at a well near Haran
stops.q: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we. And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him. And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

stops.n: Set out with her family from Bethel
stops.q: And they journeyed from Beth-el; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.

stops.n: Died and was buried on the road to Ephrath, that is, Bethlehem
stops.q: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Beth-lehem.

heroes.name: Esau
heroes.about: Jacob's elder brother

stops.n: Settled in the hill country of Seir
stops.q: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

stops.n: Buried his father Isaac together with Jacob
stops.q: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned. And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years. And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

heroes.name: Joseph
heroes.about: Sold by his brothers, he became ruler of Egypt

stops.n: His father sent him from the valley of Hebron to his brothers
stops.q: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

stops.n: Looked for his brothers near Shechem
stops.q: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

stops.n: Found his brothers at Dothan, where he was sold
stops.q: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.

stops.n: Was taken down to Egypt and sold to Potiphar
stops.q: AND Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.

stops.n: Met his father Israel in the land of Goshen
stops.q: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

heroes.name: Moses
heroes.about: Led the people out of Egypt and received the Law at Sinai

stops.n: Grew up in Egypt in the house of Pharaoh's daughter
stops.q: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.

stops.n: Fled from Pharaoh to the land of Midian
stops.q: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.

stops.n: At Horeb, the mountain of God, he saw the burning bush
stops.q: NOW Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.

stops.n: Led the people through the Red Sea
stops.q: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

stops.n: Threw a tree into the bitter water, and it became sweet
stops.q: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah. And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink? And he cried unto the Lord; and the Lord shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,

stops.n: Camp by twelve springs and seventy palm trees
stops.q: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.

stops.n: There was no water at Rephidim; Moses brought it out of the rock
stops.q: AND all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the Lord, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.

stops.n: Camp at Kadesh: here the people grumbled for lack of water
stops.q: THEN came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

stops.n: Went up Mount Hor with Aaron
stops.q: And Moses did as the Lord commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

stops.n: From Mount Nebo he saw the whole Promised Land
stops.q: AND Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the Lord shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,

stops.n: Died in the land of Moab
stops.q: So Moses the servant of the Lord died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the Lord.

heroes.name: Aaron
heroes.about: Brother of Moses, the first high priest

stops.n: Met Moses at the mountain of God
stops.q: And the Lord said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.

stops.n: At the Lord's word stretched out his rod over the waters of Egypt
stops.q: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.

stops.n: At Kadesh the people gathered against Moses and Aaron
stops.q: THEN came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

stops.n: Died on the top of Mount Hor
stops.q: And Moses did as the Lord commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation. And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.

heroes.name: Miriam
heroes.about: Sister of Moses and Aaron, a prophetess

stops.n: With a timbrel she sang to the Lord after crossing the sea
stops.q: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances. And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea. So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

stops.n: Died and was buried at Kadesh
stops.q: THEN came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

heroes.name: Jethro
heroes.about: Priest of Midian, father-in-law of Moses

stops.n: He was the priest of Midian; Moses kept his flock
stops.q: NOW Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.

heroes.name: Zipporah
heroes.about: Wife of Moses, daughter of Jethro

stops.n: One of the seven daughters of the priest of Midian; she became Moses' wife
stops.q: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.

heroes.name: Joshua
heroes.about: Successor of Moses, led the people into the Promised Land

stops.n: Fought against Amalek
stops.q: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim. And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand. So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

stops.n: Led the people across the Jordan
stops.q: And the Lord said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee. And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.

stops.n: Set up twelve stones from the Jordan at Gilgal
stops.q: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.

stops.n: The Lord delivered Jericho into his hands
stops.q: NOW Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in. And the Lord said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.

stops.n: Took the city of Ai
stops.q: AND the Lord said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:

stops.n: "Sun, stand still over Gibeon!"
stops.q: Then spake Joshua to the Lord in the day when the Lord delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.

stops.n: Cast lots for the land before the Lord at Shiloh
stops.q: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the Lord: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.

stops.n: Gathered all the tribes of Israel at Shechem
stops.q: AND Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

heroes.name: Caleb
heroes.about: The spy who trusted God

stops.n: Was sent by Moses from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land
stops.q: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the Lord said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh-barnea.

stops.n: Received Hebron as his inheritance
stops.q: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.

heroes.name: Rahab
heroes.about: Hid the spies of Israel

stops.n: Lived in Jericho and hid two spies
stops.q: AND Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

heroes.name: Deborah
heroes.about: Prophetess and judge of Israel

stops.n: Judged the people under a palm tree between Ramah and Bethel
stops.q: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth-el in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

stops.n: Sat under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel
stops.q: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth-el in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

stops.n: Sent Barak to gather an army on Mount Tabor
stops.q: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh-naphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the Lord God of Israel commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

heroes.name: Barak
heroes.about: Commander who defeated Sisera

stops.n: Came down from Mount Tabor with ten thousand men
stops.q: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which the Lord hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the Lord gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

heroes.name: Gideon
heroes.about: Judge who defeated the Midianites with three hundred men

stops.n: Was threshing wheat at Ophrah when the angel appeared
stops.q: And there came an angel of the Lord, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abi-ezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.

stops.n: Asked the men of Succoth for bread for his weary soldiers
stops.q: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

heroes.name: Samson
heroes.about: A Nazirite given great strength

stops.n: The Spirit of the Lord began to move him between Zorah and Eshtaol
stops.q: And the Spirit of the Lord began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.

stops.n: Went down to Timnah and saw a Philistine woman there
stops.q: AND Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.

stops.n: Went down to Ashkelon and struck down thirty men
stops.q: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father’s house.

stops.n: Carried the city gates of Gaza to the top of a hill
stops.q: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took the doors of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and went away with them, bar and all, and put them upon his shoulders, and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron.

heroes.name: Ruth
heroes.about: A Moabitess, great-grandmother of King David

stops.n: Came from the country of Moab
stops.q: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

stops.n: Came to Bethlehem with her mother-in-law at the beginning of the harvest
stops.q: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

heroes.name: Naomi
heroes.about: Ruth's mother-in-law

stops.n: Was from Bethlehem in Judah
stops.q: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Beth-lehem-judah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.

stops.n: Went with her husband to the country of Moab to escape famine
stops.q: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Beth-lehem-judah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.

heroes.name: Boaz
heroes.about: Ruth's husband, great-grandfather of King David

stops.n: Came from Bethlehem to his reapers in the field
stops.q: And, behold, Boaz came from Beth-lehem, and said unto the reapers, The Lord be with you. And they answered him, The Lord bless thee.

heroes.name: Hannah
heroes.about: Prayed to God for her son Samuel

stops.n: Brought little Samuel to the house of the Lord at Shiloh
stops.q: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of flour, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of the Lord in Shiloh: and the child was young.

stops.n: Lived with her husband Elkanah in Ramah
stops.q: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before the Lord, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the Lord remembered her.

heroes.name: Eli
heroes.about: High priest, Samuel's teacher

stops.n: Was priest at Shiloh
stops.q: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the Lord of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the Lord, were there.

heroes.name: Samuel
heroes.about: Prophet and last judge; anointed Saul and David

stops.n: The Lord revealed himself to him at Shiloh
stops.q: And the Lord appeared again in Shiloh: for the Lord revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the Lord.

stops.n: Gathered all Israel at Mizpah for prayer
stops.q: And Samuel said, Gather all Israel to Mizpeh, and I will pray for you unto the Lord.

stops.n: Every year he went round Bethel, Gilgal and Mizpah
stops.q: And he went from year to year in circuit to Beth-el, and Gilgal, and Mizpeh, and judged Israel in all those places.

stops.n: Judged Israel at Gilgal too
stops.q: And he went from year to year in circuit to Beth-el, and Gilgal, and Mizpeh, and judged Israel in all those places.

stops.n: His home was in Ramah
stops.q: And his return was to Ramah; for there was his house; and there he judged Israel; and there he built an altar unto the Lord.

stops.n: Came to Bethlehem to anoint David
stops.q: And Samuel did that which the Lord spake, and came to Beth-lehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, Comest thou peaceably?

heroes.name: Saul
heroes.about: First king of Israel

stops.n: Here the lot fell on Saul
stops.q: And Samuel called the people together unto the Lord to Mizpeh;

stops.n: His home was in Gibeah
stops.q: And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and there went with him a band of men, whose hearts God had touched.

stops.n: The people made him king at Gilgal
stops.q: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the Lord in Gilgal; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the Lord; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

stops.n: Was encamped with his army at Michmash
stops.q: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Beth-el, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.

stops.n: Sought out a medium at Endor
stops.q: Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and inquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold, there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at En-dor.

stops.n: Fell with his sons on Mount Gilboa
stops.q: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

heroes.name: Jonathan
heroes.about: Saul's son, David's faithful friend

stops.n: Held Gibeah of Benjamin with a thousand men
stops.q: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Beth-el, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.

stops.n: Climbed up with his armour-bearer to the Philistines at Michmash
stops.q: And between the passages, by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines’ garrison, there was a sharp rock on the one side, and a sharp rock on the other side: and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh. The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash, and the other southward over against Gibeah.

stops.n: Fell in battle on Mount Gilboa
stops.q: NOW the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa. And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, Saul’s sons.

heroes.name: David
heroes.about: Shepherd who slew Goliath, king of Israel

stops.n: Was from Bethlehem in Judah
stops.q: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Beth-lehem-judah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons: and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul.

stops.n: Struck down Goliath in the Valley of Elah
stops.q: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom thou slewest in the valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if thou wilt take that, take it: for there is no other save that here. And David said, There is none like that; give it me.

stops.n: Lived with Achish, king of Gath
stops.q: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.

stops.n: Hid in the cave of Adullam
stops.q: DAVID therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father’s house heard it, they went down thither to him.

stops.n: Wrote a psalm when he was in the wilderness of Judah
stops.q: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah. O GOD, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

stops.n: Lived in the strongholds of En Gedi
stops.q: AND it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of En-gedi.

stops.n: Was given the town of Ziklag by Achish
stops.q: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.

stops.n: Was anointed at Hebron king over the house of Judah
stops.q: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron. And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, That the men of Jabesh-gilead were they that buried Saul.

stops.n: Took the stronghold of Zion, the City of David
stops.q: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.

stops.n: Took refuge from Absalom at Mahanaim
stops.q: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

heroes.name: Absalom
heroes.about: David's son who rebelled against his father

stops.n: Fled to Geshur and stayed there three years
stops.q: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

stops.n: Proclaimed himself king at Hebron
stops.q: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.

stops.n: Entered Jerusalem with the people
stops.q: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

heroes.name: Solomon
heroes.about: The wise king who built the Temple

stops.n: Offered a thousand burnt offerings; God gave him wisdom
stops.q: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.

stops.n: Reigned in Jerusalem forty years
stops.q: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

stops.n: Built the Temple on Mount Moriah
stops.q: THEN Solomon began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the L ord appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

stops.n: Built a fleet of ships at Ezion Geber
stops.q: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion-geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.

heroes.name: Hiram
heroes.about: King who sent cedars for the Temple

stops.n: King of Tyre, friend of David; sent his servants to Solomon
stops.q: AND Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.

heroes.name: Ahab
heroes.about: Wicked king of Israel

stops.n: Reigned over Israel in Samaria
stops.q: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.

stops.n: Gathered the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel
stops.q: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.

stops.n: Coveted Naboth's vineyard beside his palace in Jezreel
stops.q: AND it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

stops.n: Went to war against Ramoth Gilead and was killed
stops.q: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.

heroes.name: Jezebel
heroes.about: Ahab's wife, persecutor of the prophets

stops.n: Was the daughter of Ethbaal, king of the Sidonians
stops.q: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.

stops.n: Looked out of the window when Jehu came to Jezreel
stops.q: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.

heroes.name: Elijah
heroes.about: Prophet taken up to heaven in a chariot of fire

stops.n: A widow at Zarephath fed him during the famine
stops.q: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.

stops.n: On Mount Carmel fire fell on his sacrifice
stops.q: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel’s table.

stops.n: Ran ahead of Ahab's chariot all the way to Jezreel
stops.q: And the hand of the Lord was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

stops.n: Fleeing from Jezebel, he came to Beersheba
stops.q: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beer-sheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.

stops.n: Walked forty days to Horeb, the mountain of God
stops.q: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.

stops.n: Went with Elisha to Bethel
stops.q: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the Lord hath sent me to Beth-el. And Elisha said unto him, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Beth-el.

stops.n: Came with Elisha to Jericho
stops.q: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the Lord hath sent me to Jericho. And he said, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.

stops.n: Struck the waters of the Jordan with his cloak
stops.q: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.

heroes.name: Elisha
heroes.about: Disciple and successor of Elijah

stops.n: Struck with Elijah's cloak, and the Jordan parted
stops.q: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan; And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the Lord God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.

stops.n: Healed the water of the spring at Jericho
stops.q: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not? And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water is naught, and the ground barren.

stops.n: Went up from Jericho to Bethel
stops.q: And he went up from thence unto Beth-el: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.

stops.n: Went on to Mount Carmel
stops.q: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.

stops.n: Returned to Samaria
stops.q: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.

stops.n: The Shunammite woman prepared an upper room for him
stops.q: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.

stops.n: At Dothan the hills around him were full of chariots of fire
stops.q: And he said, Go and spy where he is, that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothan.

stops.n: Came to Damascus when King Ben-Hadad was ill
stops.q: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Ben-hadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, The man of God is come hither.

heroes.name: Naaman
heroes.about: Syrian commander healed of leprosy

stops.n: Praised the rivers of Damascus above all the waters of Israel
stops.q: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.

stops.n: A servant girl told of the prophet in Samaria
stops.q: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.

stops.n: Dipped seven times in the Jordan and was cleansed
stops.q: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

heroes.name: Jonah
heroes.about: Prophet who spent three days inside the great fish

stops.n: Was a prophet from Gath Hepher
stops.q: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of the Lord God of Israel, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which was of Gath-hepher.

stops.n: Trying to flee from the Lord, he boarded a ship at Joppa
stops.q: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord.

stops.n: Preached in Nineveh, and the city repented
stops.q: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of the Lord. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days’ journey.

heroes.name: Josiah
heroes.about: Godly king in whose days the Book of the Law was found

stops.n: Reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years
stops.q: JOSIAH was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.

stops.n: Tore down the altar at Bethel
stops.q: Moreover the altar that was at Beth-el, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, and stamped it small to powder, and burned the grove.

stops.n: Was killed at Megiddo
stops.q: In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

heroes.name: Sennacherib
heroes.about: King of Assyria who besieged Judah

stops.n: Was encamped with his army at Lachish
stops.q: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

stops.n: Returned and stayed in Nineveh
stops.q: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

heroes.name: Isaiah
heroes.about: Prophet who foretold the Messiah

stops.n: Prophesied concerning Judah and Jerusalem
stops.q: THE vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

heroes.name: Jeremiah
heroes.about: The weeping prophet

stops.n: Was one of the priests at Anathoth
stops.q: THE words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

stops.n: During the siege of Jerusalem he was shut up in the court of the guard
stops.q: For then the king of Babylon’s army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which was in the king of Judah’s house.

stops.n: Was released from his chains at Ramah
stops.q: THE word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, after that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah, which were carried away captive unto Babylon.

stops.n: Went to Gedaliah at Mizpah
stops.q: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land.

stops.n: Was taken to Egypt, to Tahpanhes
stops.q: Then came the word of the Lord unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

heroes.name: Ezekiel
heroes.about: Prophet in the Babylonian captivity

stops.n: Was among the exiles by the river Chebar
stops.q: The word of the Lord came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the Lord was there upon him.

stops.n: Was carried in a vision to Jerusalem
stops.q: And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of mine head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.

heroes.name: Daniel
heroes.about: Prophet saved from the lions' den

stops.n: Was made ruler over the province of Babylon
stops.q: Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief of the governors over all the wise men of Babylon.

stops.n: Saw a vision in Susa by the river Ulai
stops.q: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I was at Shushan in the palace, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.

heroes.name: Nebuchadnezzar
heroes.about: King of Babylon who destroyed Jerusalem

stops.n: Came to Jerusalem while his servants were besieging it
stops.q: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged. And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.

stops.n: "Is not this great Babylon, which I have built?"
stops.q: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.

heroes.name: Esther
heroes.about: Queen who saved her people

stops.n: Was taken into the king's palace in Susa
stops.q: So it came to pass, when the king’s commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace, to the custody of Hegai, that Esther was brought also unto the king’s house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.

heroes.name: Mordecai
heroes.about: Esther's guardian

stops.n: Lived in Susa, the royal city
stops.q: Now in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew, whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite;

heroes.name: Ezra
heroes.about: Scribe who brought the people back to the Law

stops.n: Came up from Babylon
stops.q: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the Lord God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the Lord his God upon him.

stops.n: Arrived in Jerusalem in the fifth month
stops.q: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

heroes.name: Nehemiah
heroes.about: Rebuilt the walls of Jerusalem

stops.n: Was cupbearer to the king in Susa
stops.q: THE words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,

stops.n: Came to Jerusalem and inspected the walls by night
stops.q: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

heroes.name: Jesus Christ
heroes.about: Son of God, Saviour of the world

stops.n: Was born in Bethlehem of Judea
stops.q: NOW when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judæa in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

stops.n: As a baby was carried to Egypt away from Herod
stops.q: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:

stops.n: Was brought up in Nazareth
stops.q: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.

stops.n: Came to the Jordan to be baptized by John
stops.q: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.

stops.n: First miracle: turned water into wine at a wedding
stops.q: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

stops.n: Made his home in Capernaum by the sea
stops.q: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:

stops.n: Talked with the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well
stops.q: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

stops.n: Raised the widow's son
stops.q: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.

stops.n: Healed a blind man
stops.q: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.

stops.n: Withdrew to the region of Tyre and Sidon
stops.q: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.

stops.n: Asked the disciples: "Who do you say that I am?"
stops.q: When Jesus came into the coasts of Cæsarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

stops.n: Passed through Jericho and stayed with Zacchaeus
stops.q: AND Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.

stops.n: Came to Bethany, where he had raised Lazarus
stops.q: THEN Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

stops.n: Entered Jerusalem, and the whole city was stirred
stops.q: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

stops.n: Prayed in the garden before his arrest
stops.q: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.

stops.n: Carried the cross to the Place of the Skull, Golgotha
stops.q: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

stops.n: Risen, he walked with two disciples to Emmaus
stops.q: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs. And they talked together of all these things which had happened. And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.

heroes.name: Mary
heroes.about: Mother of the Lord Jesus

stops.n: The angel Gabriel came to her in Nazareth
stops.q: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

stops.n: Came to Bethlehem with Joseph for the census
stops.q: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judæa, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:) To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

stops.n: Fled with the Child to Egypt
stops.q: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:

stops.n: Was at the wedding in Cana of Galilee
stops.q: AND the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:

stops.n: Went with Jesus to Capernaum
stops.q: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.

stops.n: Stood by the cross
stops.q: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

stops.n: Prayed with the apostles in Jerusalem
stops.q: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day’s journey. And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphæus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James. These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.

heroes.name: Joseph
heroes.about: Betrothed of the Virgin Mary

stops.n: Went from Nazareth for the census
stops.q: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judæa, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

stops.n: Came to Bethlehem, the city of David
stops.q: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judæa, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

stops.n: By night took the Child and his mother and went to Egypt
stops.q: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:

stops.n: Searched for the boy Jesus in Jerusalem
stops.q: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.

heroes.name: John the Baptist
heroes.about: Prophet who baptized Jesus

stops.n: Preached in the wilderness of Judea
stops.q: IN those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judæa,

stops.n: Baptized in the Jordan
stops.q: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.

stops.n: Baptized at Bethabara by the Jordan
stops.q: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.

heroes.name: Peter
heroes.about: Apostle, a fisherman from Galilee

stops.n: Was from Bethsaida
stops.q: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

stops.n: In his house in Capernaum Jesus healed his mother-in-law
stops.q: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

stops.n: Confessed: "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God"
stops.q: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

stops.n: Was with Jesus in Gethsemane
stops.q: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder. And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.

stops.n: Waited with the apostles for the Holy Spirit in Jerusalem
stops.q: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day’s journey. And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphæus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.

stops.n: Was sent with John to the believers in Samaria
stops.q: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:

stops.n: Healed the paralysed Aeneas
stops.q: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.

stops.n: Raised Tabitha to life at Joppa
stops.q: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

stops.n: Baptized the household of the centurion Cornelius
stops.q: And the morrow after they entered into Cæsarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

stops.n: The apostle Paul rebuked him at Antioch
stops.q: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

heroes.name: Andrew
heroes.about: The first-called apostle, Peter's brother

stops.n: Was from Bethsaida
stops.q: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

stops.n: Shared a house with Simon in Capernaum
stops.q: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

heroes.name: Philip
heroes.about: Apostle who brought Nathanael

stops.n: Was from Bethsaida, the town of Andrew and Peter
stops.q: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

heroes.name: Nathanael
heroes.about: An Israelite in whom there is no guile

stops.n: Was from Cana in Galilee
stops.q: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

heroes.name: Zacchaeus
heroes.about: Chief tax collector who climbed a sycamore tree

stops.n: Was the chief tax collector in Jericho
stops.q: AND Jesus entered and passed through Jericho. And, behold, there was a man named Zacchæus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.

heroes.name: Lazarus
heroes.about: Friend of Jesus, raised on the fourth day

stops.n: Lived in Bethany with his sisters Mary and Martha
stops.q: NOW a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

heroes.name: Martha
heroes.about: Sister of Lazarus

stops.n: Lived in Bethany
stops.q: NOW a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

heroes.name: Mary Magdalene
heroes.about: First to see the risen Christ

stops.n: Stood by the cross of Jesus
stops.q: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

heroes.name: Stephen
heroes.about: First martyr for Christ

stops.n: Did great wonders in Jerusalem
stops.q: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith. And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.

heroes.name: Philip
heroes.about: One of the seven deacons

stops.n: Proclaimed Christ in a city of Samaria
stops.q: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.

stops.n: After baptizing the eunuch he found himself at Azotus
stops.q: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Cæsarea.

stops.n: Lived in Caesarea; Paul stayed at his house
stops.q: And the next day we that were of Paul’s company departed, and came unto Cæsarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.

heroes.name: Tabitha
heroes.about: Disciple raised to life by Peter

stops.n: Lived in Joppa and was full of good works
stops.q: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.

heroes.name: Cornelius
heroes.about: Roman centurion, the first Gentile to be baptized

stops.n: Was a centurion in Caesarea
stops.q: THERE was a certain man in Cæsarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,

heroes.name: Paul
heroes.about: Apostle to the Gentiles, made long journeys

stops.n: Was from Tarsus
stops.q: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,

stops.n: Came to Jerusalem after his conversion
stops.q: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.

stops.n: On the road to Damascus he was blinded and believed
stops.q: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.

stops.n: Taught a whole year in Antioch
stops.q: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.

stops.n: Preached in the synagogues of Salamis on Cyprus
stops.q: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.

stops.n: Sailing from Cyprus, he came to Perga
stops.q: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.

stops.n: Spoke in the synagogue of Pisidian Antioch
stops.q: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.

stops.n: Many believed in Iconium
stops.q: AND it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.

stops.n: Healed a man lame from birth; later he was stoned
stops.q: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,

stops.n: Went on with Barnabas to Derbe
stops.q: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.

stops.n: Saw a man of Macedonia in a vision by night
stops.q: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas. And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

stops.n: Founded the first church in Europe
stops.q: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.

stops.n: Reasoned with the Jews for three Sabbaths
stops.q: NOW when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,

stops.n: The Bereans examined the Scriptures every day
stops.q: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.

stops.n: Spoke on the Areopagus about the unknown God
stops.q: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.

stops.n: Lived and taught in Corinth for a year and a half
stops.q: AFTER these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;

stops.n: Taught for two years in Ephesus
stops.q: AND it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,

stops.n: Said farewell to the elders of the church of Ephesus
stops.q: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.

stops.n: Spent two years as a prisoner in Caesarea
stops.q: Who, when they came to Cæsarea, and delivered the epistle to the governor, presented Paul also before him.

stops.n: Survived a shipwreck on the island of Melita
stops.q: AND when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.

stops.n: Stayed three days in Syracuse
stops.q: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.

stops.n: Landed in Italy at Puteoli
stops.q: And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:

stops.n: Lived in Rome under guard and preached
stops.q: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.

heroes.name: Barnabas
heroes.about: Companion of Paul, "son of encouragement"

stops.n: Brought the converted Saul to the apostles
stops.q: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple. But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.

stops.n: Was sent by the church to Antioch
stops.q: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.

stops.n: Went to Tarsus to look for Saul
stops.q: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:

stops.n: Preached with Paul in Salamis
stops.q: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.

stops.n: Shook off the dust and went with Paul to Iconium
stops.q: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.

stops.n: The people of Lystra called him Zeus
stops.q: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.

stops.n: Went on with Paul to Derbe
stops.q: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.

heroes.name: Silas
heroes.about: Paul's companion on the second journey

stops.n: In Philippi he was thrown into prison with Paul
stops.q: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.

stops.n: Many in Thessalonica joined Paul and Silas
stops.q: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.

stops.n: Was sent away by night with Paul to Berea
stops.q: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.

stops.n: Came from Macedonia to Paul in Corinth
stops.q: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.

heroes.name: Timothy
heroes.about: Disciple and helper of Paul

stops.n: Was a disciple at Lystra
stops.q: THEN came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:

stops.n: Stayed behind with Silas in Berea
stops.q: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people. And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.

stops.n: Paul sent him from Athens to the Thessalonians
stops.q: WHEREFORE when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone; And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:

stops.n: Came to Paul in Corinth
stops.q: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.

stops.n: Stayed in Ephesus at Paul's request
stops.q: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

heroes.name: Lydia
heroes.about: Seller of purple, the first baptized in Europe

stops.n: Was from the city of Thyatira
stops.q: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

stops.n: Was baptized in Philippi and welcomed Paul into her home
stops.q: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

heroes.name: Aquila and Priscilla
heroes.about: Tentmaker couple, friends of Paul

stops.n: Left Rome by order of Claudius
stops.q: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.

stops.n: Took Paul in and worked with him in Corinth
stops.q: AFTER these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth; And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.

stops.n: Stayed in Ephesus and instructed Apollos
stops.q: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.

heroes.name: Apollos
heroes.about: An eloquent teacher

stops.n: Was a native of Alexandria
stops.q: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.

stops.n: Came to Ephesus
stops.q: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.

stops.n: Served in Corinth
stops.q: AND it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,

heroes.name: John
heroes.about: The beloved disciple, author of Revelation

stops.n: Was among the apostles in Jerusalem
stops.q: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:

stops.n: Was sent with Peter to Samaria
stops.q: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:

stops.n: Received the Revelation on the island of Patmos
stops.q: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.

heroes.name: Titus
heroes.about: Disciple of Paul

stops.n: Went up to Jerusalem with Paul and Barnabas
stops.q: THEN fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.

stops.n: Was left in Crete to appoint elders
stops.q: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
